project.objective: Determine the date and place of death of Nathaniel Coombs (b. c. 1810, Kentucky), last documented alive in the 1870 Barren County, Kentucky census

questions.question: When and where did Nathaniel Coombs (b. c. 1810, Barren County, Kentucky) die?
questions.rationale: The census trail goes cold after 1870. No Kentucky death certificate is expected (statewide registration began 1911); the county estate administration is the primary death evidence.

items.rationale: Kentucky Probate Records, 1727-1990 covers Barren County; an indexed name search is the cheapest first pass.
The probate collection is about 1% record-indexed, so a nil on the name index is not absence. A full-text co-occurrence search of the county's probate volumes is the next pass.

Administrator appointments and bonds are entered in the county court order books. On FamilySearch the Barren County order books for 1870-1885 are digitized as browse-only image groups (volume_search shows 0% record-searchable), so the remaining path is reading the order-book pages directly, starting from each volume's index.

log.notes: Kentucky Probate Records, 1727-1990: no Coombs entry for Barren County 1870-1890. The collection is about 1% record-indexed, so this nil means un-indexed, not absent.
